rca_of_issue: Original bug: AI Detect close button did not reliably return to Home when opened from the bottom tab (Expo Router had no back stack for a tab route, causing router.back() to no-op or bounce). Fix (verified): The AI tab now renders the full AiDetectScreen directly with mode='tab' and its close handler explicitly calls router.navigate('/(tabs)') — deterministic navigation to Home regardless of entry path. The /ai-detect modal route uses mode='modal' with router.back() and router.replace('/(tabs)') fallback. Removing the previously ineffective tabPress interceptor from _layout.tsx also removed a source of flicker. Playwright evidence: URL correctly becomes '/' after close in both entry paths and across 2 repeat cycles; Ionicons glyph codepoints confirm the icon differs per mode (home vs X).
